title: jasper-deploy dashboard build manifest
description: The unified manifest consumed by build_dashlets.ps1 / gen_dashboard.py. It carries BOTH the report-build spec (db/datasource/queries) AND the dashboard grid layout (x/y/width/height per tile). For each report dashlet build_dashlets.ps1 scaffolds -> compiles -> deploys -> verifies, then (-Compose) gen_dashboard.py synthesizes the dashboard descriptor + companion files. A real example lives at report/foodmart/dashboard.json.

name.description: Control (= report parameter) name; also the leaf of its repository URI.

type.description: JRS inputControl type code: 1 boolean, 2 single value, 3 single-select LOV, 4 single-select query, 5 multi value, 6 multi-select LOV, 7 multi-select query. Alternative: 'kind'.

values.description: LOV kinds (3/6): 'label=value' strings or {label,value} objects; a bare string is both label and value.

query.description: Query kinds (4/7): SQL SELECT the control runs on dataSourceUri (may reference $P{parent} for cascades).

valueColumn.description: Query kinds: column supplying the parameter value.

visibleColumns.description: Query kinds: columns shown in the prompt. Default [valueColumn].

dataType.description: Value kinds (2/5): the dataType sub-resource type.

db.description: PostgreSQL database name used when scaffolding report tiles (column introspection runs against it). Default postgis_34_sample.

host.description: PostgreSQL host for scaffolding introspection. Default localhost.

port.description: PostgreSQL port for scaffolding introspection. Default 5432.

user.description: PostgreSQL user for scaffolding introspection. Default postgres (password comes from $env:PGPASSWORD).

dataSourceUri.description: Repository URI of the JDBC datasource the report tiles run against, e.g. /public/Samples/Data_Sources/FoodmartDataSource. Must already exist on the server.

folder.description: Repository folder the dashboard and its report tiles are deployed under, e.g. /reports/foodmart.

name.description: Leaf name of the composed dashboard resource (the folder + name form its repository URI).

label.description: Human-readable dashboard label. The component id is derived from this via re.sub('[^0-9A-Za-z]','_', label), so keep labels unique across tiles.

showExportButton.description: Show the dashboard Export button (dashboardProperties.showExportButton). Default false.

showPrintButton.description: Show the dashboard Print button (dashboardProperties.showPrintButton). Default false.

filterButtonsPosition.description: Where the filter strip's Apply/Reset buttons sit (filterGroup.buttonsPosition). Only used when 'filters' is set.

filterFloating.description: Float the filter strip instead of docking it (filterGroup.floating). Only used when 'filters' is set.

filterStripHeight.description: Height (grid rows) of the dashboard-level filter strip. Every tile's y is offset by it. Synced back from the live layout by sync_manifest.py. Only used when 'filters' is set.

filters.description: Dashboard-level filter strip: one inputControl component per control NAME (resolved under filterControlFolder), wired to every report tile. The controls must exist on the server -- declare them in 'controls' (ensure_controls.ps1 / promote -EnsureControls creates them).

filterControlFolder.description: Repository folder holding the filter controls. Default <folder>/controls.

filterOwner.description: Report unit that declares the filter parameters (ownerResourceId). Default: the first report dashlet.

controls.description: Input controls this dashboard needs (declarative spec consumed by ensure_controls.ps1, compose_dashboard.ps1 -EnsureControls and promote.ps1 -EnsureControls). Either an object { folder, dataSourceUri, controls:[...] } or a bare array of control objects (folder then defaults to filterControlFolder / <folder>/controls, datasource to the manifest dataSourceUri). Idempotent: GET first, create only when absent. Example: fixtures/controls.example.json.

folder.description: Repository folder the controls (and their _lov/_query/_dt sub-resources) are created in.

dataSourceUri.description: Datasource the query controls run against.

canvasColor.description: Background colour of the dashboard canvas (the gutters between tiles), written to DashboardProperties.canvasColor. Default #ffffff. Set it to the tiles' own page background (e.g. #000032 for the navy POS boards) so the gutters do not read as white seams.

outDir.description: Local output directory for generated jrxml/jasper artifacts, e.g. report\foodmart (Windows path, backslashes escaped in JSON).

cols.description: Column count used by -AutoGrid when tile x/y/width/height are omitted. Default 2. Ignored when explicit grid placement is given.

wiring.description: Optional cross-dashlet (filter) wiring appended to the synthesized wiring.data. Each entry broadcasts a producer event to one or more consumer tiles.

producer.description: Producer event in the form 'ComponentId:output', e.g. 'A:out'.

consumers.description: Consumer events in the form 'ComponentId:param', e.g. ['B:param'].

dashlets.description: The dashboard tiles. Each tile has a 'kind' of report (default), text, or image, plus grid placement x/y/width/height on a 40-wide grid.

items.description: A single dashboard tile. Kind-specific fields are validated by the if/then branches below; all kinds share the grid placement fields.

kind.description: Tile kind. Omit (or 'report') for a deployed report dashlet; 'text' for a static text tile; 'image' for an image tile. Only report tiles carry a repository resource.

name.description: Tile name. For a report tile this is the leaf resource name (scaffolded + deployed under 'folder'). For text/image it is the component name only.

scaleToFit.description: Report tile scaling (reportUnit.scaleToFit). Default width; 'container' matches a designer-set 'Scale to fit: container'.

showTitleBar.description: Report tile title bar (reportUnit.showTitleBar). Synced from the live dashboard by sync_manifest.py.

resource.description: Compose-only manifests: repository URI of an already-deployed report tile (instead of 'name' + build spec).

jrxml.description: Local jrxml for this tile (relative to the manifest). promote.ps1 -Manifest deploys it with deploy_report.ps1 -Overwrite; when absent the tile is looked up in outDir, then beside the manifest, else export+imported from the source server.

controls.description: Input controls to attach to this report unit after a (re)deploy: control names (resolved under filterControlFolder) or full URIs. Omit to inherit whatever the SOURCE report unit has attached (promote.ps1).

x.description: Grid column origin on the 40-wide grid. Omit all of x/y/width/height to let -AutoGrid place tiles.

height.description: Tile height in grid rows. For a report tile honor tile_height/tile_width >= page_height/page_width to avoid scrollbars (see dashboard-model.md).

then.description: Text tile: a static label rendered directly in the dashboard (NOT dynamic; for a live value use a tiny report tile instead).

color.description: Text color as a CSS rgb()/rgba() string, e.g. 'rgba(20,40,80,1)'.

background.description: Tile background color as a CSS rgb()/rgba() string.

then.description: Image tile: a logo or static image. Carries no repository resource.

url.description: Image source: a repository ref 'repo:/path' or an absolute http(s):// URL.

then.description: Report tile (default kind): scaffolded from SQL into a tabular report with a chart in its summary band, then deployed and verified.

subtitle.description: Report subtitle text under the title.

chart.description: Summary-band chart type. bar (default styling) and pie/pie3d get the Actian-blue gradient branding.

chartCategory.description: Query column used for the chart category axis. Defaults to the first text column.

chartValue.description: Query column used for the chart value/measure. Defaults to the first numeric column.

chartSeries.description: Query column that splits a multi-series category chart (e.g. year for a grouped/stacked bar).

landscape.description: Emit a landscape page (wider than tall) for wide charts/tables.

chartLabelRotation.description: Rotation (degrees) of category-axis tick labels so long labels do not truncate, e.g. -45.

queryFile.description: Path to a .sql file holding the report query (preferred for long queries). Mutually exclusive with 'query'.

query.description: Inline SQL SELECT for the report. Use 'queryFile' instead for long queries. Must not begin with WITH (the JRS validator rejects leading CTEs).
